integrity: The explicit counterexample is proved by exact graph equations, an irreducible separable cubic collision polynomial, and compactly supported Euler characteristic after base change to the complex numbers. The rational-point necessity follows from geometric collision counting after base change; sufficiency is the initiating paper's ruled-surface and affine-bundle construction with the unique collision point required to be rational. The bundled arithmetic checker is a consistency check only.
scientific_limitations: The corrected equivalence is proved only in characteristic zero. No optimal formulation is claimed for imperfect positive-characteristic fields. The result concerns the field of definition of the collision support and does not dispute the algebraically closed case or the Jacobian-counterexample application of the initiating paper.
title: A rational-point correction to an affine-complement criterion
